title: Access Control Information Model
description: openEHR Access Control Information Model specification (draft)
micro_summary: Access directives and controller policy as facts
summary: A concrete ACCESS_CONTROL_SETTINGS scheme for EHR_ACCESS that records the subject's access directives (consent, restriction, opt-out, delegation) and sensitivity labels as versioned facts, and a versioned ACCESS_POLICY of a controller that classifies data and states its access requirements. The classes hold facts; the decision procedure is fixed by the scheme.
keywords: access control, consent, EHR_ACCESS, ABAC, openehr
